{{Image}}
[[File:Grievous-CGSWG.png|thumb|right|250px|Grievous's cyborg legs were LX-44.]]
'''LX-44 robotic legs''',<ref name="Star Wars Fandex">''[[Star Wars Fandex Deluxe Edition]]''</ref> also known as '''LX-44 legs''', were [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Limb/Legends|legs]] used on the rebuilding of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] into a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]].<ref name="ROTS:TVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The particular ones Grievous used were upgraded slightly.<ref name="Star Wars Fact File Part 13">[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 13|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 13]]</ref> Along with Grievous's former body, the legs were still utilized when the [[Cyberneticist/Legends|cyberneticist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nycolai Kinesworthy]]<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref> was hired to create advanced [[Battle droid/Legends|combat droid]] technologies named [[N-K Project|project "N-K,"]] a reference to his own name,<ref name="Lord">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/86/indexp2.html|text=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War|int=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War}}</ref> resulting in [[N-K Necrosis]].<ref name="SWG:RotW" />

{{Tech-stub}}
